name: Superpixel-guide Efficient Sampling (SES)
definition: A training strategy that uses SLIC superpixels as the smallest processing units to guide ray sampling, addressing slow convergence and scattered sampling in high-resolution NeRF training by focusing computation on complex regions.
summary: SES is a NeRF training strategy using SLIC superpixels to guide ray sampling, reducing computational overhead by adapting to image content unlike rigid quadtree methods.
